originalTitle: Jim Cramer says investors aren't ditching tech — they just want cheaper stocks
summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said investors aren’t abandoning AI or technology stocks — they’re rotating out of high-multiple names and into cheaper stocks.
content:
CNBC's Jim Cramer said Wednesday investors aren't abandoning artificial intelligence or technology stocks altogether — they're ditching expensive stocks.

"There's no revulsion to the data center or AI stocks or even momentum plays, it's just that when bond yields go up, money managers dump their expensive stocks and swap into cheaper ones," the " Mad Money " host said.

Some of the market's highest-flying technology stocks have come under pressure in recent weeks, fueling concerns that enthusiasm for AI is fading. Cramer said that's not the case and investors have simply become less willing to pay premium valuations for stocks that need near-perfect results to keep climbing.

A common way to compare valuations is the forward price-to-earnings multiple , which divides a company's share price by its expected earnings per share over the next 12 months. The higher the multiple, the more investors are paying for each dollar of expected earnings.

"The buyers aren't fleeing from the data center or tech in general, they're just fearful of high multiple tech stocks, ... because they have to be perfect," he said.

Cramer pointed to MongoDB , which trades at roughly 52 times expected earnings over the next 12 months. Shares of the database software company dropped around 13% Wednesday despite reporting better-than-expected earnings and upbeat guidance.

Dell , on the other hand, trades at roughly 16 times forward earnings and rallied 16% after reporting strong results Tuesday. For Cramer, the contrasting reactions show that investors remain willing to buy technology and AI stocks when valuations and fundamentals are attractive.

"As it happens, many of the data center plays have high multiples, but the ones that don't, like Dell, are doing fine," Cramer said.

Nvidia offered another example, he said. Despite being at the center of the AI boom, the chipmaker trades at roughly 17 times expected earnings over the next 12 months — significantly cheaper than many slower-growing technology companies.

Cramer said Nvidia's relatively low multiple reflects skepticism that its extraordinary earnings growth can continue as investors question the durability of data center spending. He said those concerns are misplaced, pointing to Dell's results as evidence that customers are beginning to generate meaningful returns from their AI investments.

"What the heck is Nvidia doing with such a low price to earnings multiple despite the phenomenal growth?" Cramer said.

For Cramer, the recent sell-off isn't evidence that the AI trade is broken. Investors still want AI and technology stocks, he said, but they're becoming much more selective about the price they're willing to pay.

"We hear that investors are fleeing the artificial intelligence trade. Or that they don't want to own technology anymore. Or the data center's become a nightmare. Or, worst of all, the momentum trade is broken," he said. "These are all wrong. ... They're getting the symptoms right — these groups truly are going down — but missing the real cause."

chineseTitle: 吉姆·克莱默 (吉姆·克莱默) 表示，投资者并没有放弃科技股，他们只是想要更便宜的股票
chineseSummary: CNBC 的 Jim Cramer 表示，投资者并没有放弃人工智能或科技股，他们正在从高市盈率股票转向更便宜的股票。
chineseContent:
CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 周三表示，投资者并没有完全放弃人工智能或科技股，而是放弃了昂贵的股票。

“数据中心或人工智能股票甚至动量股都没有反感，只是当债券收益率上升时，基金经理会抛售昂贵的股票，转而购买更便宜的股票，”《Mad Money》主持人表示。

最近几周，市场上一些涨幅最高的科技股面临压力，引发了人们对人工智能热情正在消退的担忧。克莱默表示，情况并非如此，投资者只是变得不太愿意为需要近乎完美的业绩才能继续攀升的股票支付溢价估值。

比较估值的一种常见方法是远期市盈率，即用公司的股价除以未来 12 个月的预期每股收益。倍数越高，投资者为每一美元的预期收益支付的费用就越多。

他表示：“买家并不是逃离数据中心或一般科技公司，他们只是害怕高倍数科技股……因为它们必须是完美的。”

Cramer 指出 MongoDB 的交易价格约为未来 12 个月预期收益的 52 倍。尽管公布了好于预期的盈利和乐观的指引，但这家数据库软件公司的股价周三仍下跌了约 13%。

另一方面，戴尔的预期市盈率约为 16 倍，周二公布强劲业绩后股价上涨 16%。对于克莱默来说，对比鲜明的反应表明，当估值和基本面有吸引力时，投资者仍然愿意购买科技和人工智能股票。

“事实上，许多数据中心公司的市盈率都很高，但那些市盈率不高的公司，比如戴尔，却表现不错，”克莱默说。

他说，英伟达提供了另一个例子。尽管处于人工智能热潮的中心，这家芯片制造商的未来 12 个月预期市盈率约为 17 倍，远低于许多增长缓慢的科技公司。

克莱默表示，由于投资者质疑数据中心支出的持久性，英伟达相对较低的市盈率反映出人们对其非凡的盈利增长能否持续的怀疑。他表示这些担忧是多余的，并指出戴尔的业绩证明客户开始从人工智能投资中获得有意义的回报。

“尽管增长惊人，英伟达到底在用如此低的市盈率做什么？”克莱默说。

对于克莱默来说，最近的抛售并不能证明人工智能行业已经崩溃。他表示，投资者仍然想要人工智能和科技股，但他们对愿意支付的价格变得更加挑剔。

“我们听说投资者正在逃离人工智能行业。或者他们不想再拥有技术。或者数据中心已成为一场噩梦。或者，最糟糕的是，势头交易被打破，”他说。 “这些都是错误的……他们的症状是正确的——这些群体确实在下降——但却忽略了真正的原因。”
